documents.name: Trial note.md
documents.text:
# Paper glider trial
The fictional Northgate club compares two paper gliders. Both use the same paper and launch point. The second glider changes only the fold at the wing tip. The team records the flight time for each launch and repeats both designs three times.
## Why this plan
Keeping the paper and launch point unchanged makes the wing-tip fold the intended difference between the two designs. Repeating launches lets the team see whether a single launch was unusual. No measured flight times or winning design are supplied.
